## ✨ Features

| Feature | Description |
|---|---|
| 🧠 **AI Background Removal** | Remove unwanted backgrounds and isolate the main subject. |
| ⚡ **Fast Workflow** | Select an image, process it, and export the result in a few taps. |
| 🖼️ **Transparent PNG** | Export images with transparent backgrounds for flexible reuse. |
| ✨ **Clean Results** | Designed around clean and professional-looking output. |
| 🎯 **Minimal Interface** | Simple UI focused on the task instead of unnecessary controls. |
| 📱 **Android Optimized** | Built specifically for modern Android devices. |

## 🎯 Designed to Be Simple

Image Background Eraser focuses on one thing:

> **Remove the background without making the process complicated.**

```text
Select Image
     ↓
Remove Background
     ↓
Preview Result
     ↓
Save / Share
```

---

## 🚀 How It Works

### 01 — Select
Choose an image from your device.

### 02 — Remove
Process the image and isolate the main subject from its background.

### 03 — Export
Save the result as a transparent image and use it wherever you need it.
